body.message:
Unfortunately, we did not enjoy our stay. This apartment had the same issues as the previous unit: the AC was extremely loud, and there were unpleasant smells, particularly a strong smell coming from the drains.

As I was extremely busy with work, I simply did not have time to keep moving from one apartment to another. However, these units really need to be properly inspected and all maintenance issues resolved before being rented out to guests.

I regularly stay at MAG 318 whenever I come to Dubai, and unfortunately, this was by far the worst unit I have stayed in. I hope you will take this feedback seriously.
